sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5 series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.title: MiniCPM5 2B DSpark by OpenBMB — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact text model that punches above its weight class for its 2B parameter size, handling surprisingly long contexts up to 131K tokens. It's the kind of model you'd reach for when you need something lightweight that can still process lengthy documents without truncating. The trade-off is that, being 2B parameters, it won't match larger models on complex reasoning tasks.
